notes:
{認|みと}める has two main uses: to recognize/acknowledge something, or to admit/confess.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {才能|さいのう}を{認|みと}める: to recognize talent
- {間違|まちが}いを{認|みと}める: to admit a mistake
- {正式|せいしき}に{認|みと}める: to officially recognize
- 〜と{認|みと}める: to acknowledge that ~

PASSIVE FORM:
{認|みと}められる: to be recognized/acknowledged

RELATED:
- {認|みと}め{印|いん}: personal seal, approval stamp
- {承認|しょうにん}: approval, authorization
